{{Top|leg}}
A '''temperature regulator''' was component in [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems. The life support system of a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] utilized a temperature regulator,<ref name="SBB">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref> as did certain models of [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
